sealed with a hug

Open when you need a hug

Hey, my love.

If you're reading this, something might be feeling heavy right now. You don't have to explain it, and you don't have to be strong for a little while. Take one slow breath with me.

You're allowed to be tired. You're allowed to need a pause. You have spent so much of your kindness on other people, and I see it, always.

Whatever today was, you are still deeply loved, exactly as you are. Close your eyes and imagine my arms around you, holding you until the weight feels a little lighter.

I'm proud of you, and I'm always on your side. ♡

Chapter Six · Promises

A little box, only for you

There's one more thing I want you to read, slowly, with all my love.

♡
sealed with love

Open your letter

My dearest girl,

I still think it is beautiful that our story began with a conversation on 6 September at 21:16. I don't know what the future will look like in every detail, but I know I want to keep making memories with you, laughing with you, and reminding you that you matter to me.

Thank you for being you. On the good days and the difficult ones, I hope I can be someone who brings you comfort, kindness, and a reason to smile. I may not always find the perfect words, but my feelings are real.

Here's to all the conversations still waiting for us, all the memories we haven't made yet, and all the little moments that will mean everything someday.

With all my love, always. ♡
